maddeler.e:
نجن (form I)
# نَجُنُّ (najunnu) /na.d͡ʒun.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of جَنَّ (janna)
# نُجَنُّ (nujannu) /nu.d͡ʒan.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of جَنَّ (janna) and جُنَّ (junna)
# نَجُنَّ (najunna) /na.d͡ʒun.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of جَنَّ (janna)
# نُجَنَّ (nujanna) /nu.d͡ʒan.na/: first-person plural non-pas
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
